_doc: The free-roam valley (brief 2.10; v4). Owner: roam. Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_valley. TankRoamMap builds the map from a seed (ctx.rng on the host, carried in the snapshot): length_m drawn in [lo, hi] (game metres); first_zone and last_zone at the two ends, the middle zones once each in a seeded order, with forest between two of them at forest_between odds; zone lengths drawn from len_m and scaled to fill the road. Terrain: points terrain_step_m apart, each drawn from its zone's terrain_pct, moving at most terrain_max_step_pct from the last, flat over end_flat_m at both ends; grades are for travel east and negated westward, always clamped to terrain_pct (-3..+5%, inside BRIEF 4.6.6's -3..+6%). start_m: where the hull's centre starts (the west end, facing east); end_m: the turning places, where the road stops for the hull's centre. drive_out_s: the WARMUP drive-out (>= 300 s, BRIEF 4.6.8); overtime_s: how long a fight in progress may run past time up (max_s = min_s + overtime_s). Strongpoints: one holding force of one strongpoints.enemy per listed zone at a seeded spot (at least min_gap_m apart, clear_ends_m from either end), on the field once its spot lies within spawn_m ahead in the travel direction, back respawn_s after it falls, never in the drive-out or after time up. Nothing is ever behind the tank: a turn clears the field. The tank halts while a strongpoint stands and for a heavy tank holding within engage_heavy_m (metres of range). Patrols: one every every_s seconds of WORK time (drawn), always ahead (with less than clear_ahead_m of road ahead it retries), a kind drawn by weight (heavy only past heavy_after_s of WORK time and with no heavy alive), far kinds in the far panel, near kinds from the bushes, counts drawn from each unit's [lo, hi] and scaled like mission counts (crew and difficulty), trimmed to max_alive enemies on the field (none fit: retry_s later); none after time up. fight_m: a far enemy within this range, or a near threat, is a fight in progress at time up. Turn: an 8 s stop with the flip at its midpoint, a 30 s cooldown, the Autopilot turning autopilot_wait_s after reaching an end, and the crew turning on its own after forced_wait_s when a hand-playing driver does not. Points per kill by enemy type, per evaded shot, per breakdown or lost tank and per full kilometre driven in the roam phase. Grades: points per minute of WORK time. The valley runs through the forest: the zone ids stay (the wire and the map), each zone is a forest variant or a base clearing (backdrop, TankIds.BACKDROPS; label: the HUD strip's name): forest the pines, lake a fir hollow, village a forest camp and quarry a lumber yard (bases), meadow a birch glade; every strongpoint stands at a little base (strongpoints.backdrop).
